name: Larvotto Supérieur Monaco Telecom data center
notes: Larvotto Supérieur at 19 Boulevard du Larvotto is reported as a 35-apartment public development with a Monaco Telecom basement data center. DCD reported council approval, start planned in 2024, completion in 2027, and 1,550 sqm across two subterranean levels; DCmag reported 1,318 sqm and a revised 2028 objective. Legimonaco search result for project law no. 1.123 places 19 Boulevard du Larvotto in zone 1 L'Annonciade of the ordered La Rousse quarter; Journal de Monaco confirms Vallon de La Rousse as an ordered quarter. Capacity in MW not reported.
